svg.data-weight-configured-scope: populated, 17.0 lb in the datasheet; unpopulated is 12.0 lb
svg.data-overall-mm: 431.8 x 44 x 331 without brackets (17 x 1.75 x 13.0 in)
svg.data-input-dc: dual feed; maximum input load 325 A at 45 C per panel, de-rated to 200 A at 70 C; input wire 2/0 AWG to 350 MCM
svg.data-output-breaker-max: 60 A single-pole; the UL rating holds to 48 A continuous per output
svg.data-power-max-scope: the alarm card alone at 48 V (30 mA); 0.48 W at 24 V and 0.22 W at 12 V. THE MONITORING CARD ALSO DRAWS FROM THE A AND B FEEDS, and no document held states how much (gap monitoring-card-draw), so this figure is a floor for the panel, not its total. Separately the guide gives a nominal power LOSS of less than 45 W per side at 325 A and 48 V, which is heat in the conductors and not a draw.
svg.data-operating-temp: to 70 C - 325 A per panel at 45 C, de-rated to 200 A at 70 C; no lower limit is stated
svg.data-alarm-contacts: Form C relay per side, 2 A at 30 VDC and 0.6 A at 60 VDC, on wire-wrap terminals
